services.name: All Charters
services.desc: Miss Susie Charters offers several Chesapeake Bay fishing charter types, including Chesapeake Bay fishing trips targeting rockfish, bluefish, and Spanish mackerel; specialized blue catfish charters on the Potomac River; and light tackle trophy trips for species like Cobia and Red Drum. Private group and walk-on options are available for anglers of all experience. What makes us unique is our adaptability. Based on the season and where the fish are biting, we depart from key locations such as Solomons Island, Pasadena, National Harbor, and Ridge, Maryland. services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Our Fishing Charters from National Harbor puts you on the water fast. Sitting along the Potomac River just minutes from Washington, DC, this departure point gives anglers from the DC metro area direct access to some of the most exciting fishing on the East Coast - without a long drive to the Bay. Miss Susie Charters launches from Tantallon Marina in National Harbor, giving your group a convenient and productive starting point for Potomac River and Chesapeake Bay fishing. Whether you are chasing rockfish, targeting trophy blue catfish, or looking for a fun group outing close to the city, our professional captains bring the gear, the knowledge, and the results.
